claim_one_line: E82 IS A CLASS, BUT A SMALL AND SHALLOW ONE: 3 CANDIDATES IN 798 KILLS, AND THE PRIMARY ONE SURVIVES RE-TEST WITH ITS MISSING LINK SUPPLIED (PREREGISTRATION sealed sha256 94b1f14c... and PUSHED at 504d6bd BEFORE any cell ran). WHY THE ARC EXISTS: E82 entered the error ledger today from this seat's OWN correction of xB005's Q3, and a seat that mints an error class from a single self-inflicted error without checking whether it recurs has committed the same over-reach it is auditing. THE STRATUM WAS UNSWEPT: B742 (2026-07-21) hunted banked negatives on 'a kill never EARNED by computation' -- 213 triaged, 33 P1, 32 recomputed, 2 revived -- but an E82 kill IS earned by computation and its computation is CORRECT; what fails is the step from the computed links to the conclusion, so B742 would have passed xB005's Q3. S1 PASS: the lexicon is calibrated BOTH ways -- it fires on a planted E82 kill and does NOT class B727, the record's own sound form, as a candidate. S2: 30 raw candidates of 798 kills. TWO SELF-CORRECTIONS BEFORE ANY NUMBER WAS REPORTED. (1) A first draft added 'by construction' to the lexicon while coding; it is not in the sealed list, it is descriptive prose (B425's 'golden BY CONSTRUCTION'), and it drove 27 of an initial 46 on its own -- withdrawn, restoring the sealed lexicon. (2) REPORTING 30 WOULD HAVE BEEN THE EXACT OVER-REACH THIS ARC AUDITS, so every raw candidate was read and adjudicated with its reason recorded and asserted to cover the sweep's output exactly: BASE_RATE 10 (a base-rate/look-elsewhere argument WITH the rate computed), LINK_NAMED 8 (the link IS supplied; the 600-char window missed it), PROSE 5, MODEL 3, NOT_A_KILL 1, E82 3. S2b PASS, |C_adjudicated| = 3, INSIDE THE SEALED PRIOR'S RANGE 1-8. WHAT THE ADJUDICATION SAYS ABOUT THE CORPUS, AND IT IS NOT WHAT THIS SEAT EXPECTED TO REPORT: the record is DISCIPLINED about linkage and the sweep's own output proves it -- ten kills carry a computed base rate, eight name the theorem or definition doing the work, and three arcs are the MODEL (B1223 states the discriminator itself; B772 tested its own linkage hypothesis and REFUTED IT, '12/14 negatives are object-native and genuinely seam-independent'; B995 computed the dependence (1-r)^5 and VOIDED ITS OWN INSTRUMENT). E82 is the exception here, not the rule. S3, THE PRIMARY CANDIDATE RE-TESTED: B146 writes that B145's surviving arms are 'near-tautological ... (ONE FACT: short word ~ low volume ~ palindromic period)', three properties chained by '~' with no map, and the 'near-tautological' is the evidential downgrade. On 135 once-punctured-torus bundles b++<w>, w cyclically reduced of length <= 9: 'short word ~ low volume' is FALSE (1095 pairs where the shorter word has the larger volume; LLRR len 4 vol 3.6639 > LLLLR len 5 vol 3.1773), word length barely carries volume information (spread 2.54x at fixed length 9, 3.4762..8.8240), and 'low volume ~ palindromic' is FALSE (912 pairs where a non-palindromic bundle has lower volume; LLRLRR 5.6254 < LRLRLR 6.0896). THE THREE ARE NOT ONE FACT AND THE CHAIN AS WRITTEN IS FALSE. AND THE OTHER HALF, WHICH THE HEADLINE CARRIES: at the bottom of the volume spectrum the coupling is REAL AND STRUCTURAL -- lowest palindromic volume 2.0299 against lowest non-palindromic 5.6254, all 12 lowest-volume bundles palindromic, and AT EVERY WORD LENGTH THE VOLUME MINIMISER IS THE MONOTONE WORD L^(n-1)R (verified, lengths 2-9), which reversed is R L^(n-1), a rotation of itself, hence cyclically palindromic BY INSPECTION. THAT IS THE MAP B146 NEVER WROTE: volume-minimality DOES force palindromicity in the extremal regime where B146 applies it, via an explicit family rather than an '~'. B146'S KILL SURVIVES; what is corrected is its JUSTIFICATION -- a scoping note, NOT a revival, matching the sealed S3 prior exactly. Two secondary candidates reported and not re-tested: B142 (the kappa equality is the S_3 cusp symmetry 'restated', not exhibited -- low leverage, since B142's decisive arm is the trace field being Q(sqrt-7) or Q(i), not Q(sqrt-3)) and B1096 (completeness of content and emptiness of layer 'are the same fact', a reason offered but no map). NO ARC IS RE-VERDICTED AND NONE IS RETRACTED -- this seat audits and reports; B146 and the two secondaries go to cc as proposals with the computation attached. RECALL IS NOT MEASURED, only calibrated on planted controls: a kill phrased without one of the sealed constructs is invisible to the sweep, the deliberate B806 trade, and the true class may be larger than 3. Corpus audit and census computation. Gate 5 absolute; no value, no generation count, nothing promotes to CLAIMS.md.
